name: heel v2
note: heel v2 (2026-10-13), for heel_v2_post.py / heel_v2_field.py, appended after P-ankle1 in place of P-heel1 (heel v1's pads read faint and wobbly, its bottom edge lumpy, and its corner arc left a kink where it met the heel back). Anatomy review finding 7. Written for the +x foot; the -x foot uses it mirrored on its own grid. blurX: as heel v1, merges the leg column's ridge down the heel back; lift: the sole moved up .005 by a vertical shift (side walls stay put), except on an elliptical heel contact patch, so the heel stays on the floor plane (no lift, by the brief); pads: four oval toe pads and one three-lobed metatarsal pad (a body and three rear lobes, smooth union), flattened ellipsoid domes sitting on the foot's own underside and clipped at the floor, joined with a small smooth minimum so each has a clean groove round it; corner: a line fitted to the measured heel back (z -.935 to -.905) and the floor, joined by a fillet of radius .03 tangent to both, intersected with the foot by a smooth maximum (hard within .002 to .008 of the floor), faded in x round the heel center, with an across-the-foot blur below it; openings: a ball opening of radius .004 over the bottom of the foot rolls the old sole slab's edge lip; keepContact: in the core of the heel's contact patch, within .002 of the floor and in front of y .012, the field from before the corner and the openings is restored, so the heel's contact stays exactly on the floor plane; partBox: |x| from .18 (in by .20), z below -.85 (in by -.88). World units, +y back.
